title: BPS Statistical Service Chatbot
excerpt: AI-powered WhatsApp chatbot for Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) Kota Padang with zero-hallucination architecture.
problem: BPS Kota Padang needed an automated, always-available channel for citizens to access statistical data and services via WhatsApp, while ensuring responses are grounded strictly in verified data.
architecture: End-to-end automated pipeline: WhatsApp messages received via WAHA (WhatsApp HTTP API), routed through n8n workflow orchestration, processed by Google Gemini LLM grounded on verified external data (Google Sheets), and responses sent back via WhatsApp. Deployed with Docker and Docker Compose on a Hostinger VPS.
